Commentary.Commentary: That is it from this game then! We have the four teams which are going to be part of the Semi Finals. The first one is going to be played between Windies and Australia and the second one is a clash between England and South Africa. The first semi finals takes place on the 30th of this month and the action begins at 3.30 am IST (10.00 pm GMT, the previous day). The build up though begins a lot earlier. Do join us for that, till then, take care and goodbye!

Sunne Luus, the South African skipper, says that they are very happy. She adds that she is happy for Mignon du Preez and says that preparation would not have been better for the semis. She adds that the partnership between Lara Goodall and Laura Wolvaardt was crucial and all this will help going into the semis. She says that South Africa will be very proud of them and the way they have played in the tournament.

Mithali Raj, the Indian skipper, says that girls gave their all and it was a very good game She adds that she is proud of the girls for coming so far though this game ended their campaign. Tells that she thought that they have good score on the board and they have defended such score in the past. Mentions that Jhulan Goswami's experience was missed but it was chance for other girls to step up. Says that everything should come to an end and thanks fans for all the support and adds that everyone should keep supporting women’s cricket.

Mignon du Preez is the Player of the match. She starts by thanking god, she says she has been very fortunate and her teammates have been very supportive. Adds they gave themselves time and wanted to take it deep as they know what they can do towards the end. Mentions it has been tough few weeks but she is now heading into the semi finals with momentum. Ends by thanking the supporters.
Stay tuned for the presentation.

The Indians missed Jhulan Goswami with the new ball as they leaked a lot of runs in the first 15 overs or so. Despite the early wicket. Laura Wolvaardt and Lara Goodall  managed to score freely. Harmanpreet Kaur though was the game-changer for the Indians, not only with the ball but also in the field. She got two vital breakthroughs and then also a couple of run outs. However, the likes of Rana and Pooja just were not at their best. Also, the dropped catch of Mignon by Mandhana did not help as that probably was the reason for the loss. India were just not good enough with the ball and the dew which came in later on also did not help. Earlier in the day, after electing to bat, courtesy a combined batting effort, India put up a really good score on the board on a wicket which was very good to bat on. South Africa though managed to chase it down. It is the second highest chase in the history of the World Cup.

The start though wasn't the best for South Africa, chasing this big score as they lost Lee early. Lara Goodall and Laura Wolvaardt got things back on track with a 100-plus stand. Laura Wolvaardt played yet another brilliant innings but both fell in quick succession. Then Sune Luus and Kapp along with Mignon du Preez  got South Africa back into the game but when Kapp fell, it seemed it is going to be India who are going to come out on top. Mignon du Preez though hung in there, she took it deep. She was also helped by Chloe Tryon who played a handy cameo but it was Mignon's calmness which helped her side get over the line. Yes, she was lucky but take nothing away from the superb knock she played.

Oh... no balls and oversteppings. The saying goes that we should learn from our mistakes. Take your minds back to 24th September, 2021. It was the second ODI during India Women's tour of Australia in Mackay. Australia needed 3 to win from 2 balls and Nicola Carey was caught. But it was deemed a full toss no ball. History almost repeated itself in this game, with Deepti overstepping. In that game it was Jhulan Goswami and this time it is the talented all-rounder, Deepti Sharma. Mistakes at a crucial juncture. Nerves? Well, not for the Proteas. The Men are known as chokers but the Women certainly have proved a point, haven't they?

FOUR! The runs just continue to flow! On the pads, this is worked fine on the leg side for another boundary.
FOUR! Put away! Short and outside off, this is cut through point for a boundary. Fifty for Laura. She is having an amazing tournament. India need to get her out if they want to win this game.
On off again, defended.
Tossed up on off, kept out.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad seems to be in some pain. The ball has hit her fingers while she was trying to stop the ball. She gets some treatment on her fingers and is ready to resume now.
Tossed up on off, this is hit back towards the bowler who lets it through. One taken.
We'll bowled! Slower and outside off. Lara is early in the sweep. She misses.
Uppishly but in the gap! Outside off, this is lofted wide of cover for one.
A dot to end! On off, this is pushed to mid off.
On the pads, Lara looks to flick but it hits the pad. The keeper dives to her right and takes it. An appeal but nothing.
A single! Outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Two more! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for two.
On off, this is pushed to cover for one.
On middle, it is kept out.
On middle, this is worked to mid-widket. A misfield by the fielder and a run is taken.
Well bowled! Nice and slow. Around off, Lara looks to reverse sweep but is early in the stroke. She misses to get hit on the arm.
Shorter and outside off, this is pushed to covers.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Lara comes down the track and eases it down to long on for one.
On off, this is pushed to mid off for one. A little bit of turn for Gayakwad.
That is a poor shot! Angled away from off. Lara looks to heave it over mid on but misses.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Good length and on off, blocked.

India need to restrict South Africa Women to 173 or below to finish third and book the place in the second semi-final. However, if South Africa crosses that mark then, India will have to settle for number 4 spot even if they win this game.
FOUR! Wonderful timing! Full and on middle, Lara stands tall and times it through mid-wicket. This one races away to the fence. India under big pressure now.
A quick run! On off, this is pushed to cover for a quick run.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
A single to end another hit over. South Africa are cruising along at the moment. Outside off, this is slapped through cover for one.
FOUR! Creamed! It has gone absolutely quiet in the ground and by that, we can make out who is on top. Fuller and outside off, this is driven through covers and it races away to the fence.
Now takes one as it is worked through mid-wicket.
Two more! The paddle sweep comes out yet again, it is hit fine on the leg side. Two taken.
Tossed up on off, this is pushed to covers.
FOUR! It is raining boundaries now! This one is dragged! Outside off, Lara plays it through mid-wicket and this one races away to the fence.
Powerplay 2 time. A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over. Rajeshwari Gayakwad is into the attack now.
FOUR! Hammered! Shorter in length and on middle, Laura slams it through square leg and this one races away to the fence. 50 up and South Africa have recovered well after losing an early wicket.
Tossed up on off, kept out.
Shorter and on off, this is played back to the bowler.
Two more! On middle, this is worked fine on the leg side for two.
She wasn't in control of the shot there! On middle, Lara looks to play the paddle sweep, it goes more off the splice but lands safe in thr short fine leg region. One taken.
Flatter and on middle, kept out.
Good length and on middle, defended.
FOUR! That has gone to the fence in no time! Wonderful. Full and outside off, it is timed through covers. There is a sweeper in the deep but she had no chance.
FOUR! Put away! One on the pads, poor ball with not a lot of protection on the leg side. This is clipped through square leg for a boundary.
Three taken! On the fuller side. Lara times it wonderfully, it races through covers for three.
This is even wider outside off, Lara pushes it to covers.
Fuller and on off, this is driven to mid off.
A dot to end! On middle, this is clipped to mid-wicket.
On middle, kept out.
The paddle scoop, it is dragged towards fine leg from outside off. Three taken.
A single as this is pushed down to long on.
On off, shortish, it is pushed to cover.
On middle, blocked.
A single to end a very good over for South Africa. On middle, this is flicked through square leg for one.
FOUR! Timed down the ground! This time it is hit wonderfully. Fuller and on middle, this is pushed back past the bowler and down to the mid on fence.
Two more! On the pads, this is worked through square leg for two.
FOUR! This time the gap is found! Can't bowl it there, she'll find the gap on most occasions. Fuller and on off, this is driven through covers for a boundary.
Does not find the gap! Fuller and around off, this is driven but to covers.
Fuller and on middle, this is driven hard back to the bowler who makes a half stop with her right hand. That must have stung.
On off, blocked. A tidy over by Sharma.
On the stumps, kept out.
On middle, blocked.
On the pads, Lara looks to flick, it hits the pad and rolls down to fine leg. Two taken. Leg byes!
On off, blocked.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed to cover for one.
On off, kept out.
On middle, defended.

OUT! DIRECT HIT AND IT IS REFERRED! Lee is well short. There was never a run there. On middle, Laura works it to mid-wicket and takes off. Lee too goes for it. Kaur gets to the ball quickly and hits the stumps at the keeper's end. It is taken upstairs but Lee is well short. Huge wicket and it is the perfect start for India.
Misses out this time! Another one on the shorter side. Laura chops it to covers.
FOUR! Up and over! Laura loves width. This is short and outside off, she cuts it over point for a boundary.
On off, shorter, this is pushed to covers.
Flatter and on off, defended.
Loopy ball on off, Lee pushes it to covers.
Tossed up on off, blocked.
Lee brings ou the favourite sweep shot, she hits it towards deep square leg. The fielder runs to her right and stops it well. Two taken.
Slower through the air and on middle, it is worked to mid-wicket.
On middle, this is flicked towards square leg for one.
A dot to end! On off again, this is kept out again.
On off, this is defended.
FOUR! Whipped away! On middle, Lee walks across and whips it through square leg for a boundary.
On a length, on middle. Laura Wolvaardt works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Goes fuller on off. Laura Wolvaardt drives it to covers.
Back of a length, outside off. Laura Wolvaardt looks to cut but mistimes it.
Slower in the air, on off. Lee defends it off the front foot.
A single now! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Shorter and on off, Laura pushes it to covers.
On off, blocked.
On middle, shorter, it is worked to mid-wicket.

That is a beauty! How has that missed the off pole. This starts around middle and off and drifts away. Laura looks to block but this one holds its line. It goes past the outside edge and just about kisses the off pole.
Deepti Sharma to start from the other end.
On off, this is pushed to covers. A dot to end a tidy first over from Meghna.
On off, length, this is pushed to covers.
Good length and on off, Lee pushes it to covers.
Good stuff! Another one on a length and around off, Lee lunges and keeps it out.
On off, defended.
Outside off, away swinger. Left alone.
WIDE! South Africa are underway! Down the leg side. Lee looks to flick but misses. Wided.
